summary: BEACOM AS (org. no. 927 081 474) is a private limited company (AS) based in Lillestrøm, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2021-05-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 71.129 (Annen teknisk konsulentvirksomhet); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2024 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 648 935 and net income was -NOK 94 321. CEO: Pierre Benny Lennart Andersson; board chair: Pierre Benny Lennart Andersson.
